mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the weight rail and counterweight was most worthwhile: the two steps made a clear, connected physical assembly.

leastWorthwhile.text: The repeated results simply saying an item was created gave little sense of what had physically changed.

surprise.text: The assembly changed names from Whale to Whale carrier when the weight rail was fitted, which was a little confusing.

arbitrary.text: No fitting felt purposeless, though the changing assembly names made progress harder to follow.

continue.text: Probably not immediately: the construction steps were clear, but the sparse text results made the finished build less engaging.
